title: Posture Analysis with a Plumb Line — Front, Back and Side

hook.en: "Poor posture" is a feeling until you measure it. Learn the plumb-line landmarks, the three views and the objective measures that turn an opinion into a number you can track.
hook.ur: “Kharab posture” tab tak ek ehsaas hai jab tak aap naapte nahi. Plumb-line landmarks, teen views aur woh objective measures seekhein jo raay ko aise number mein badal dete hain jo track ho sake.

goal.en: By the end, you'll set up a posture assessment, name the plumb-line landmarks in side view and the symmetry checks from front and back, and choose an objective measure instead of "looks bad".
goal.ur: End tak aap posture assessment setup karenge, side view mein plumb-line landmarks aur front aur back se symmetry checks batayenge, aur “bura lagta hai” ke bajaye objective measure chunenge.

text.en: Assess posture from **three views**, feet upwards, comparing left with right. **Side view:** a plumb line should fall through the **ear, the shoulder (acromion), the greater trochanter, just in front of the knee centre and just in front of the lateral malleolus**. **Front and back:** the head, shoulders, ASISs/iliac crests, knees and feet should be level and symmetrical, with the spine in a straight line. The patient stands barefoot, in shorts, relaxed, weight evenly on both feet.
text.ur: Posture ko **teen views** se, paaon se upar ki taraf, left ko right se compare kar ke assess karein. **Side view:** plumb line **kaan, shoulder (acromion), greater trochanter, knee ke beech ke bilkul samne aur lateral malleolus ke bilkul samne** se guzarni chahiye. **Samne aur peechay:** sar, shoulders, ASIS/iliac crests, knees aur pair level aur symmetrical hon, spine seedhi line mein. Patient nange paaon, shorts mein, relaxed, wazan dono pairon par barabar khara ho.

text.en: A plumb line is a builder's spirit level for the body. A builder does not guess whether a wall is straight: they hang a string with a weight and check. The plumb line does the same for a person: it shows which segments sit in front of or behind gravity's line, and therefore which muscles work harder to hold the person up.
text.ur: Plumb line jism ke liye mistri ka spirit level hai. Mistri andaza nahi lagata ke deewar seedhi hai: woh wazan wali dori latkata hai aur dekhta hai. Plumb line insaan ke liye wohi karti hai: dikhati hai ke kaun se segments gravity ki line ke aage ya peechay hain, aur is liye kaun se muscles zyada kaam kar rahe hain.

beats.title: The plumb line in side view

intro.en: Watch the vertical line dropped from above the ear. In ideal alignment the **ear, shoulder, hip, knee and ankle** line up along it. The labels show how far each landmark sits from the line. Switch sides and notice that you always check both.
intro.ur: Kaan ke upar se girti vertical line dekhein. Ideal alignment mein **kaan, shoulder, hip, knee aur ankle** is ke saath ek line mein hotay hain. Labels dikhate hain ke har landmark line se kitna door hai. Side badlein aur dekhein ke aap hamesha dono check karte hain.

question.en: In a side view, the ear sits in front of the plumb line that passes through the shoulder. What do you call this, and which muscles are overloaded?
question.ur: Side view mein kaan us plumb line ke aage hai jo shoulder se guzarti hai. Isay kya kehte hain aur kaun se muscles par bojh parta hai?

text.en: Forward head posture; the posterior neck extensors and upper trapezius work harder
text.ur: Forward head posture; posterior neck extensors aur upper trapezius zyada kaam karte hain

feedback.en: Yes — the head acts as a heavy weight in front of the spine, so the neck extensors must hold it up (and the deep neck flexors lengthen and weaken).
feedback.ur: Haan — sar spine ke samne bhaari wazan ki tarah kaam karta hai, is liye neck extensors usay thamte hain (aur deep neck flexors lambay aur kamzor ho jate hain).

text.en: Sway-back posture; the abdominals work harder
text.ur: Sway-back posture; abdominals zyada kaam karte hain

feedback.en: Sway-back concerns the pelvis and trunk, not the head.
feedback.ur: Sway-back pelvis aur trunk ka masla hai, sar ka nahi.

text.en: Normal alignment; no muscles are loaded
text.ur: Normal alignment; kisi muscle par bojh nahi

feedback.en: Normal alignment has the ear over the shoulder.
feedback.ur: Normal alignment mein kaan shoulder ke upar hota hai.

steps.title: Prepare the patient
steps.detail: Barefoot, in shorts (and a vest or gown), standing relaxed with the weight evenly on both feet and looking ahead. Ask them to stand how they normally stand, not "to stand straight". || Patient ko tayyar karein

steps.title: Look from the front
steps.detail: Head tilt, shoulder heights, ASIS levels, knee and foot alignment (valgus, varus, toe-out). || Samne se dekhein

steps.title: Look from behind
steps.detail: Scapula position, the spine in a line, waist creases, iliac crests or PSIS levels, heel position. || Peechay se dekhein

steps.title: Look from both sides
steps.detail: The plumb-line landmarks and the spinal curves: cervical lordosis, thoracic kyphosis, lumbar lordosis, pelvic tilt, knee extension. || Dono sides se dekhein

steps.title: Check whether it corrects
steps.detail: Ask the patient to change position (stand tall, bend forward, lie down). A deviation that corrects is functional; one that stays is structural. || Dekhein ke theek hota hai ya nahi

intro.en: The head sits in front of the plumb line: the lower neck flexes and the upper neck extends. Use the **view** to see the ear moving forward of the shoulder; the labels show the offset. This is the commonest posture finding in desk workers.
intro.ur: Sar plumb line ke aage hota hai: neechli gardan flex aur oopri gardan extend hoti hai. Kaan ko shoulder se aage jata dekhein; labels offset dikhate hain. Yeh desk workers mein sab se aam posture finding hai.

text.en: **Judging by eye alone, and treating the finding as the cause of pain.** Visual rating of posture is **unreliable** between examiners, and even experienced therapists disagree on mild deviations. Use objective measures and photographs for re-assessment (craniovertebral angle, flexicurve, scoliometer, occiput-to-wall). And remember that research shows only a **weak link** between static posture and pain: many people with "poor" posture have no pain, so do not label a patient's body as "wrong" without a connection to their symptoms.
text.ur: **Sirf aankh se faisla karna, aur finding ko dard ki wajah samajhna.** Posture ki visual rating examiners ke beech **bharosay ke qabil nahi**, aur tajarbe-kar therapists bhi halki deviations par ikhtilaf karte hain. Re-assessment ke liye objective measures aur photographs use karein (craniovertebral angle, flexicurve, scoliometer, occiput-to-wall). Aur yaad rakhein ke research static posture aur dard ke beech sirf **kamzor link** dikhati hai: bohat se “kharab” posture wale logon ko dard nahi hota, is liye mareez ke jism ko symptoms se jore bagair “ghalat” na kahein.

question.en: Which approach gives the most reliable posture information?
question.ur: Kaun sa tareeqa posture ki sab se reliable maloomat deta hai?

text.en: Objective measures (photographs with angles, flexicurve, scoliometer, occiput-to-wall) taken the same way each time
text.ur: Objective measures (angles ke saath photographs, flexicurve, scoliometer, occiput-to-wall) jo har baar ek jaise liye jayein

feedback.en: Yes — standardised, repeatable numbers can be compared between visits and between therapists.
feedback.ur: Haan — standardised, repeatable numbers visits aur therapists ke beech compare ho sakte hain.

text.en: A quick glance and a verbal description

feedback.ur: Visual impressions examiners mein mukhtalif hoti hain.

text.en: Asking the patient whether their posture looks bad
text.ur: Patient se poochna ke posture kharab lagti hai

feedback.en: That reflects their belief, not the alignment.
feedback.ur: Yeh un ka aitiqaad dikhata hai, alignment nahi.

rows.en: Corrects when the patient bends forward, lies down or stands tall on command
rows.ur: Aage jhukne, letne ya hukum par seedhe khare hone se theek ho jata hai
Patient kuch bhi kare rehta hai

rows.en: Habit, muscle imbalance, fatigue, pain guarding
rows.ur: Aadat, muscle imbalance, thakan, dard ki guarding

rows.en: Bone shape, fused segments, fixed contracture
rows.ur: Haddi ki shape, fused segments, fixed contracture

rows.en: Accept and adapt, monitor, refer if progressive or painful
rows.ur: Qubool aur adapt karein, monitor karein, progressive ya dardnak ho to refer

text.en: **Link posture to the patient's complaint.** Ask: does a change of position change the symptom? A person whose neck pain eases when they lift the screen and retract the chin has a postural component worth treating. A person with no pain and a rounded back does not need to be "fixed". Favour **movement variety** over one "perfect" position: hourly micro-breaks, strength for the neck, scapular and trunk muscles, and a workstation set up around the person.
text.ur: **Posture ko mareez ki shikayat se jorein.** Poochein: kya position badalne se symptom badalta hai? Jis shakhs ki gardan ka dard screen upar karne aur chin andar karne se kam hota hai uski ek postural component hai jis ka ilaaj banta hai. Jis ko dard nahi aur peeth gol hai usay “theek” karne ki zaroorat nahi. Ek “perfect” position ke bajaye **movement variety** ko tarjeeh dein: ghantay ke micro-breaks, gardan, scapular aur trunk muscles ki taqat, aur insaan ke gird bana workstation.

question.en: Why can't we say that a forward head causes neck pain?
question.ur: Hum yeh kyun nahi keh sakte ke forward head gardan ka dard karta hai?

answer.en: Because studies show only a weak association: many people with a forward head posture are pain free and many people with neck pain have normal alignment. Posture is one possible contributor among many (load, sleep, stress, movement habits). Treat it when it fits the patient's story, and measure change.
answer.ur: Kyunke studies sirf kamzor taluq dikhati hain: forward head wale bohat se log dard se azad hain aur gardan ke dard wale bohat se logon ki alignment normal hai. Posture bohat se contributors (bojh, neend, stress, movement ki aadatein) mein se ek mumkin hissa hai. Jab yeh patient ki kahani se milti ho to ilaaj karein, aur tabdeeli naapein.

question.en: A patient stands with one shoulder lower; it levels when she lies down. What is this?
question.ur: Patient ek shoulder neecha rakh kar khari hoti hai; let kar level ho jata hai. Yeh kya hai?

feedback.en: Yes — it corrects when gravity or the habitual position is removed.
feedback.ur: Haan — gravity ya aadat wali position hat jane par theek ho jata hai.
Structural deviations letne par bhi rehti hain.

text.en: A normal variation that cannot be measured
text.ur: Normal variation jo naapi nahi ja sakti

feedback.en: It can be measured and tracked.
feedback.ur: Yeh naapi aur track ki ja sakti hai.

text.en: **Refer** for postures that signal disease rather than habit: a rapidly progressing kyphosis or sudden thoracic pain in an older adult (vertebral fracture), a painful scoliosis or one progressing in a growing child, an acutely tilted head with fever or neck stiffness, or a fixed, stooped posture with night pain and stiffness in a young man (axial spondyloarthritis).
text.ur: **Refer karein** un postures par jo bimari ka ishara hon, aadat ka nahi: buzurg mein tezi se barhta kyphosis ya achanak thoracic dard (vertebral fracture), dardnak scoliosis ya barhte bachay mein barhti scoliosis, bukhar ya gardan ki sakhti ke saath achanak tilted sar, ya jawan mard mein raat ke dard aur sakhti ke saath fixed jhuki hui posture (axial spondyloarthritis).

summary.en: Side-view plumb line: ear, shoulder, greater trochanter, just in front of the knee and ankle; front and back views check symmetry and levels.
summary.ur: Side-view plumb line: kaan, shoulder, greater trochanter, knee aur ankle ke bilkul samne; samne aur peechay ke views symmetry aur levels check karte hain.

summary.en: Measure objectively, check whether a deviation corrects (functional) or not (structural), and link it to the patient's complaint.
summary.ur: Objective naapein, check karein ke deviation theek hoti hai (functional) ya nahi (structural), aur isay patient ki shikayat se jorein.

summary.en: Posture and pain are only weakly linked, so favour movement variety and refer progressive, painful or sudden changes.
summary.ur: Posture aur dard ka link sirf kamzor hai, is liye movement variety ko tarjeeh dein aur barhti, dardnak ya achanak tabdeeliyon ko refer karein.

back.en: Ear, shoulder (acromion), greater trochanter, just in front of the knee centre and just in front of the lateral malleolus.
back.ur: Kaan, shoulder (acromion), greater trochanter, knee ke beech ke aur lateral malleolus ke bilkul samne.

front.en: How do you tell functional from structural posture?
front.ur: Functional ko structural posture se kaise alag karte hain?

back.en: A functional deviation corrects when the patient changes position; a structural one persists.
back.ur: Functional deviation position badalne par theek ho jati hai; structural rehti hai.

front.en: Which measure tracks forward head posture?
front.ur: Forward head posture kis measure se track hoti hai?

back.en: Craniovertebral angle from a standardised photograph (and occiput-to-wall distance).
back.ur: Standardised photograph se craniovertebral angle (aur occiput-to-wall distance).

front.en: Is posture strongly linked to pain?
front.ur: Kya posture dard se mazboot taur par jura hai?

back.en: No: only a weak association; treat posture when it relates to the patient's symptoms or function.
back.ur: Nahi: sirf kamzor taluq; posture ka ilaaj tab karein jab woh patient ke symptoms ya function se jura ho.
